title: The request to the watching tool
description: Asks `mokume watch` itself to do something, as opposed to the other surfaces, which a running sketch answers. This version takes two actions: audition (from now on, a save changes only the preview, and the work's window keeps running the version it has) and leave (stop the version under audition, and the preview shows the work's version again). Placed atomically as ADR-0018 decision 3 requires, and id changes with every request. **A request whose id can be read is always answered**, with the reason when it was declined. The facet exists only while a watching tool runs, and a request left from an earlier run is not carried over.

id.description: This request's identifier. The reply echoes it back. An id already answered is not processed again: the answer left in the reply is the record. Do not reuse an id while the facet remains. **This includes a request that could not be read**: once it is answered, fixing it and placing it again under the same id is not processed — place the fixed request with a new id.

action.description: What to do. **audition** puts the tool into auditioning: nothing that is running is touched, and each save after that starts the new version as the version under audition, which only the preview shows (the version under audition before it is stopped first, so there is never more than one). A save starts a version under audition only when it changes the sources: after a leave, re-entering with the sources still as they were at the leave starts nothing, and saving the same contents again starts nothing either — change the contents and save to audition them again. **leave** stops the version under audition and shows the work's version in the preview again. **Which version a save becomes is decided by the read that picks it up**, when the tool starts that read — not when its build finishes, and for each save on its own (saving earlier contents again is decided anew by the read that picks up that save). A save picked up by a read started while auditioning stays a version under audition: a leave drops it — even while it is still being read or built, and also when it was read while another version was being built — the tool says so in its output and in the preview, and the work's window keeps its version (to show a dropped version there, change the contents and save after the leave: saving the same contents again starts nothing). The exception is a leave that cannot keep the work's version — nothing is running in the work's window, or the preview cannot go back to it: the sources at the leave are started as the work's version, and a version under audition still being read or built becomes that version instead of being dropped (it is built once). A save picked up by a read started before an audition stays the work's version even when the audition is entered while it is being read or built; leaving while that build is still running lets it become the work's version, and the saves read during the audition are decided when it finishes: dropped when the work's version is running, started as the work's version when nothing runs (the build failed or could not start). A save the tool has not started reading when a request arrives is read after it: saved just before a leave, it becomes the work's version; saved just before an audition, a version under audition. A save made while a read is under way can be picked up by that read and takes its role. That window is the watcher's reading interval (one beat of 0.25 seconds plus the time to read the sources). A name this version does not take is declined with the reason unknownAction. Further actions are added here by later versions, so a reader does not assume this list is the whole set.
